intro.text: A child named in a family record stored in one of the gemstones of Urithiru's archive, left by their mother before she departed the tower.

items.text: Preparing to leave Urithiru, Molinar's mother was allowed to leave a message, recorded in a ruby, and chose to describe her family. She named Molinar and their sibling Kmakra as the true gemstones of her life.
